15: export function updateUserProfile () {
16:   return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
17:     const loggedInUser = security.authenticatedUsers.get(req.cookies.token)
18: 
19:     if (!loggedInUser) {
20:       next(new Error('Blocked illegal activity by ' + req.socket.remoteAddress))
21:       return
22:     }
23: 
24:     try {
25:       const user = await UserModel.findByPk(loggedInUser.data.id)
26:       if (!user) {
27:         next(new Error('User not found'))
28:         return
29:       }
30: 
31:       challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.csrfChallenge, () => {
32:         const url = config.get<string>('challenges.overwriteUrlForCsrfChallenge')
33:         return ((req.headers.origin?.includes('://' + url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''))) ??
34:           (req.headers.referer?.includes('://' + url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')))) &&
35:           req.body.username !== user.username
36:       })
37: 
38:       const savedUser = await user.update({ username: req.body.username })
39:       const userWithStatus = utils.queryResultToJson(savedUser)
40:       const updatedToken = security.authorize(userWithStatus)
41:       security.authenticatedUsers.put(updatedToken, userWithStatus)
42:       res.cookie('token', updatedToken)
43:       res.location(process.env.BASE_PATH + '/profile')
44:       res.redirect(process.env.BASE_PATH + '/profile')
45:     } catch (error) {
46:       next(error)
47:     }
48:   }
49: }

13: export function servePublicFiles () {
14:   return ({ params, query }: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
15:     const file = params.file
16: 
17:     if (!file.includes('/')) {
18:       verify(file, res, next)
19:     } else {
20:       res.status(403)
21:       next(new Error('File names cannot contain forward slashes!'))
22:     }
23:   }
24: 
25:   function verify (file: string, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
26:     if (file && (endsWithAllowlistedFileType(file) || (file === 'incident-support.kdbx'))) {
27:       file = security.cutOffPoisonNullByte(file)
28: 
29:       challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.directoryListingChallenge, () => { return file.toLowerCase() === 'acquisitions.md' })
30:       verifySuccessfulPoisonNullByteExploit(file)
31: 
32:       res.sendFile(path.resolve('ftp/', file))
33:     } else {
34:       res.status(403)
35:       next(new Error('Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!'))
36:     }
37:   }
38: 
39:   function verifySuccessfulPoisonNullByteExploit (file: string) {
40:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.easterEggLevelOneChallenge, () => { return file.toLowerCase() === 'eastere.gg' })
41:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.forgottenDevBackupChallenge, () => { return file.toLowerCase() === 'package.json.bak' })
42:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.forgottenBackupChallenge, () => { return file.toLowerCase() === 'coupons_2013.md.bak' })
43:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.misplacedSignatureFileChallenge, () => { return file.toLowerCase() === 'suspicious_errors.yml' })
44: 
45:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.nullByteChallenge, () => {
46:       return challenges.easterEggLevelOneChallenge.solved || challenges.forgottenDevBackupChallenge.solved || challenges.forgottenBackupChallenge.solved ||
47:         challenges.misplacedSignatureFileChallenge.solved || file.toLowerCase() === 'encrypt.pyc'
48:     })
49:   }

24: export function summarizeLlmError (error: unknown): string {
25:   if (!(error instanceof Error)) {
26:     return String(error).split('\n')[0]
27:   }
28:   const msg = error.message
29:   if (msg.includes('Cannot connect to API') || msg.includes('ECONNREFUSED') || msg.includes('ECONNRESET') || msg.includes('ENOTFOUND')) {
30:     return 'LLM API is not reachable'
31:   }
32:   const statusCode = (error as any).statusCode
33:   if (statusCode) {
34:     return `LLM API returned status ${statusCode as number}`
35:   }
36:   return msg.split('\n')[0].replace(/:$/, '')
37: }
